head: 6 new education apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: Six learning apps released in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Education charts this week, from the CrowCards flashcards to a plant explorer.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Education charts this week
means: If you're learning something or teaching kids, most of these are one-time purchases with no subscription.
todo: Check the App Store page for the price and in-app purchases: KnowYourNotes sells optional passes.

list.name: CrowCards
list.what: A flashcard app with no account or subscription that brings the cards you struggle with back first.

list.name: KnowYourNotes™ Guitar Edition
list.what: Teaches where the notes sit on a guitar fretboard through short games.

list.name: Animal Explorers 4-in-1
list.what: Four animal games for kids with real photos and a voice that names each animal in English or Spanish.

list.name: KidKode
list.what: Teaches kids the basics of coding by helping a robot solve small problems, in 42 lessons.

list.name: Pinu Club – AI Language Buddy
list.what: Short language lessons with AI feedback on your pronunciation, streaks and weekly leagues.

list.name: botanist by THIX
list.what: Lets you explore more than 1,400 plant species and grow your own digital botanical garden.
